summary: Implemented `cycle-06-symmetric-connection-canonicalization`. Added whole-pair `фл/фл` canonicalization gated by supported catalog anchors, before generic joining expansion, producing a single `фланцевый` term. Tightened the generic `фл` expansion so slash-adjacent mixed or embedded forms do not infer/collapse connection meaning. Added focused canonicalization, hybrid retriever, and matcher regression tests. OpenSpec progress is 5/5 complete.
